title: Test-Time Preference Optimization: On-the-Fly Alignment via Iterative Textual Feedback
reasoning: The paper includes a significant section of case studies in the appendix (Example 13) that specifically evaluate and optimize the model's ability to handle moral and ethical dilemmas, such as whether it is ethical to lie to a spouse. It also utilizes safety benchmarks like BeaverTails and XSTest to evaluate its alignment framework.
